 Divi's Lab Q2 Net Profit Surges 63% to Rs 1,127 Cr
 By Rediff Money Desk , New Delhi 
 1 Minute Read Listen to Article 
 Share:     
 Nov 07, 2026 14:38
 x 
 Divi's Laboratories reports a 63.57% surge in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,127 crore, driven by a 35.39% rise in revenue. H1 net profit, however, declined. Illustration: Dominic Xavier/Rediff Key Points
 Divi's Laboratories' net profit surged 63.57% to Rs 1,127 crore in the September quarter.
 Revenue from operations for Q2 increased by 35.39% to Rs 3,676 crore.
 Total expenses for the quarter rose to Rs 2,265 crore.
 The company's net profit for the first half of the fiscal year declined by 35.39% to Rs 2,029 crore.
 New Delhi, Nov 7 (PTI) Divi's Laboratories Ltd on Saturday posted a sharp 63.57 per cent rise in net profit to Rs 1,127 crore in the September quarter due to higher revenues.
The company posted a net profit of Rs 689 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, a regulatory filing said.
Revenue from operations rose 35.39 per cent to Rs 3,676 crore during the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 2,715 crore a year earlier, it said.
Its total expenses rose to Rs 2,265 crore in the period under review from Rs 1,948 crore a year ago, it added.
The company's net profit for the first half of the current fiscal year, however, declined 35.39 per cent to Rs 2,029 crore from Rs 2,568 crore in the year-ago period, the filing added. -->
